queries.name: contains_water
queries.query: MATCH (v:passage) WHERE v.passage.text CONTAINS "water" RETURN id(v) AS vid

queries.name: contains_new_york
queries.query: MATCH (v:passage) WHERE v.passage.text CONTAINS "New York" RETURN id(v) AS vid

queries.name: starts_with_the
queries.query: MATCH (v:passage) WHERE v.passage.text STARTS WITH "The" RETURN id(v) AS vid

queries.name: ends_with_period
queries.query: MATCH (v:passage) WHERE v.passage.text ENDS WITH "." RETURN id(v) AS vid

note: Complete ID sets for these predicates only; this does not prove every index term.
